chunks: 30. Al-Hakim `Abd al-Hamid ibn `Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Husayn said: Abu Yazid ibn Mahbub al-Muzni said: al-Husayn ibn `Isa al-Bastami said: `Abd al-Samad ibn `Abd al-Warith said: Shu`bah on the authority of Khalid al-Hadhdha’ on the authority of Abu Bushr `Anbari on the authority of Humran on the authority of `Uthman ib `Affan said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: “He who dies knowing that Allah is the Truth [Haqq] will enter Heaven.”

key_terms.حَقٌّ: The Truth / Reality (referring to Allah's absolute existence and veracity)
key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّم: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What condition ensures entry into Paradise according to this hadith from al-Tawhid?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* underscores the pivotal role of *yaqin* (certainty) in Islamic eschatology, linking the internal conviction of Allah’s truthfulness directly to the promise of Paradise. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the unity of knowledge and action, where true theological understanding (*ma'rifah*) serves as the decisive criterion for salvation at the moment of death.
